item.description:
更新内容

  • 新增「定时退出应用」：设定倒计时，到点自动退出你指定的那个 App
  • 目标只能从当前正在运行的 App 中选择，倒计时从设定那一刻开始
  • 定时退出应用不读取「应用规则」的排除/仅包含列表，到点即退，不会因为该 App 在例外列表里而跳过
  • 到点只发起正常退出请求，不会强制终止；被未保存文档挡住时条目会显示「未退出」，可手动重试
  • 新增「磁盘弹出」：菜单中的单一入口，集中管理外接磁盘的立即弹出与自动弹出
  • 面板提供「立即弹出」、倒计时 / 闲置超时两种触发方式、时长与当前规则
  • 闲置模式读取整盘读写计数：连续 N 分钟没有读写后弹出，期间任何读写都会重新计时
  • 磁盘以物理设备为单位：一块 U 盘即使有多个分区，面板里也只出现一块，名字取主卷名
  • 弹出交给系统 diskutil eject，不强制弹出；磁盘被占用时会显示「未弹出」，可手动重试
  • 倒计时只在菜单打开时刷新，不新增常驻定时器
  • 菜单按用途重新分组：状态、全局配置、辅助退出、定时退出应用、磁盘弹出、应用命令

行为变化

  • 磁盘菜单不再为每块磁盘各占一行，也不再提供一键时长预设；所有磁盘操作集中在「磁盘弹出」面板
  • 闲置规则失败时会先顺延（视为仍在使用），连续 3 次无读写的失败才标记「未弹出」；倒计时规则仍然失败即标记
  • 睡眠唤醒或 App 重启会重置闲置计时，不会在掀盖或重启瞬间弹盘
  • 「启用智能退出」现在是真正的全局总开关：关闭后关窗退出与两类定时任务都不再生效
  • 关闭总开关时如果还有待执行的任务，会先弹确认，确认后一并取消
  • 总开关关闭期间无法新建定时任务；「⌘W 智能退出」「应用规则」等配置入口仍可正常使用

升级说明

  • 直接点「安装更新」即可，现有应用规则与授权状态不受影响
  • 此前设定过的 App 定时退出会在首次启动时自动迁移，显示名称与剩余时间不变
  • 升级后没有待执行的任务，因此关闭总开关的实际行为与旧版一致
  • 两项定时功能都属于 Pro，试用期内可用；试用到期不会删除已设定的规则，也不会阻止其到期执行
  • 如果电脑在倒计时期间睡眠，醒来时已超过计划时刻 5 分钟以上，该次任务会被放弃（不会补跑）；闲置规则没有过期窗口，但会在唤醒时重新计时

What's New

  • Added Quit Apps Later: set a countdown and Neat Quit quits the app you picked when it ends
  • Targets can only be apps that are currently running, and the countdown starts the moment you set it
  • Quit Apps Later ignores the Application Rules exclusion/only lists and acts on schedule, even if the app is in the exclusion list
  • Only a normal quit request is sent, never a forced termination; if unsaved documents block it, the row shows "Didn't Quit" and can be retried manually
  • Added Disk Eject: a single menu entry for immediate and scheduled ejection of external disks
  • The panel offers Eject Now, two trigger modes (countdown / idle timeout), the duration, and the current rule
  • Idle mode watches whole-disk activity counters: it ejects after N minutes without reads or writes, and any activity restarts the timer
  • Disks are grouped by physical device: a USB stick with several partitions appears once, named after its main volume
  • Ejection goes through the system diskutil eject and is never forced; a disk in use shows "Didn't Eject" and can be retried
  • The countdown refreshes only while the menu is open; no new always-on timers
  • The menu is regrouped by purpose: Status, Global, Assisted Quit, Quit Apps Later, Disk Eject, App Commands

Behavior Changes

  • The disk section no longer gives each disk its own row or one-click duration presets; all disk actions live in the Disk Eject panel
  • A failed idle rule is deferred first (treated as still in use); only after 3 consecutive failures with no activity does it show "Didn't Eject". Countdown rules still fail immediately
  • Sleep/wake and app relaunch reset the idle timer, so a disk is not ejected right after opening the lid or restarting
  • "Enable Neat Quit" is now a true global switch: turning it off disables window-close quitting and both kinds of scheduled tasks
  • If tasks are pending when you turn it off, a confirmation appears first and cancels them after you confirm
  • New scheduled tasks cannot be created while the switch is off; configuration entries such as "⌘W Neat Quit" and "App Rules" remain available

Upgrade Notes

  • Click "Install Update"; your existing app rules and license are unaffected
  • App quit timers you set earlier are migrated automatically on first launch, keeping their names and remaining time
  • No scheduled tasks exist right after upgrading, so turning the switch off behaves the same as before
  • Both scheduling features are Pro and available during the trial. Trial expiry does not delete existing rules or block them from running
  • If the Mac sleeps through a countdown deadline and wakes more than 5 minutes later, that task is dropped rather than run late. Idle rules have no expiry window, but their timer restarts on wake

更新内容

  • 「例外应用」窗口升级为「应用规则」，菜单入口同步改名
  • 新增搜索框，可按应用名称或 Bundle ID 快速筛选规则，支持一键清空和 Esc 清空
  • 新增「仅包含模式」：只对列表中的 App 智能退出；与「排除模式」互斥，切换后立即生效
  • 两种模式各自保存列表，升级不会改变现有例外规则
  • 菜单中的「加入例外 / 设为自动退出」会跟随当前模式变化
  • 规则窗口高度按内容自适应，修复新增搜索框后底部按钮被裁切的问题
  • 修复 Pro 用户菜单中仍显示「（Pro）」后缀的问题
  • 降低空闲唤醒：权限轮询调整为 2 秒，并跳过未启用 ⌘W 时的输入监控检查

升级说明

  • 直接点「安装更新」即可，无需手动操作
  • 升级后默认仍是「排除模式」，原有例外列表和行为保持不变
  • 首次切换到「仅包含模式」时列表为空，需要手动添加要自动退出的 App；切换模式本身不会退出任何已打开的 App
  • 「应用规则」属于 Pro 功能，已激活的许可证和试用状态不受影响

What's New

  • Renamed "Exception Apps" to "App Rules"; the menu entry now matches
  • Added a search field to filter rules by app name or bundle ID, with one-click and Esc clearing
  • Added "Only listed apps" mode: Neat Quit only quits apps in the list. It is mutually exclusive with "Quit all except listed" and takes effect immediately
  • Each mode keeps its own list, so existing exception rules are unchanged after upgrading
  • The "Add to Exceptions / Set to Auto Quit" menu item now follows the current mode
  • The rules window resizes to fit its content, fixing the clipped bottom buttons after adding search
  • Fixed Pro users still seeing a "(Pro)" suffix in the menu
  • Reduced idle wakeups: permission polling is now every 2 seconds, and input monitoring checks are skipped when ⌘W is disabled

Upgrade Notes

  • Click "Install Update"; no manual steps are required
  • After upgrading, the default is still "Quit all except listed", and your existing exception list and behavior are unchanged
  • "Only listed apps" starts with an empty list; add the apps you want to auto-quit manually. Switching modes does not quit any currently open apps
  • App Rules is a Pro feature; activated licenses and trial status are unaffected

更新内容

  • 修复许可证窗口无法使用 ⌘V 粘贴密钥的问题
  • 许可证窗口新增「粘贴」按钮，可直接从剪贴板填入密钥
  • 许可证窗口不再显示价格，改为说明 Pro 已解锁的功能
  • 试用天数改为从服务器读取，后续调整无需更新应用

升级说明

  • 已在 1.4.0 激活的用户升级后授权保持不变，无需重新激活
  • 如果快捷键仍不可用，可点击「粘贴」按钮或手动输入密钥
  • 每个许可证仍最多激活 3 台 Mac；换机时请先在旧设备移除授权

更新内容

  • 新增 Neat Quit Pro：一次买断（$4.99）解锁「⌘W 智能退出」与例外应用列表
  • 免费版继续提供红色关闭按钮智能退出、登录时启动和菜单栏开关
  • 新用户首次启动自动获得 7 天全功能试用，无需信用卡
  • 新增「许可证」窗口：查看激活状态与已用设备数、刷新状态、移除授权
  • 菜单直接标注哪些功能属于 Pro，试用剩余天数一目了然

升级说明

  • 1.3.6 及更早版本中用过 ⌘W、例外列表或主开关的用户，升级后自动保留 Pro，无需重新购买
  • 从 1.3.5 及更早版本升级仍需手动安装一次（Bundle ID 已变更）
  • 购买后许可证密钥会显示在订单页并发送到邮箱；在菜单栏打开「许可证…」输入即可激活
  • 每个许可证最多激活 3 台 Mac；换机时请先在旧设备点「移除授权」

更新内容

  • 新增英文界面：中文系统显示「智能退出」，英文系统显示「Neat Quit」
  • 品牌与技术标识统一为 NeatQuit：工程、安装包与更新地址不再使用 SmartClose
  • Bundle ID 更新为 fun.bgm.neatquit
  • 官网与更新源同步切换到 NeatQuit 命名

升级说明

  • 由于 Bundle ID 变更，1.3.5 及更早版本无法自动跨 ID 更新，请手动下载安装包覆盖安装一次
  • 安装后原有偏好与例外应用列表会保留
  • 从本次起，后续版本可继续通过应用内更新升级

更新内容

  • 完善更新日志：更新弹窗现在会显示标题、列表和代码样式，不再只有一行链接
  • 加固发版流程：发版前会校验安装包完整性，并强制带更新日志

升级说明

  • 本次为维护版本，功能无变化
  • 直接点「安装更新」即可，无需手动操作

更新内容

  • 自动更新改由自有服务器 app.bgm.fun 提供，国内下载更快、更稳定，不再依赖 GitHub
  • 安装包发布后会自动校验大小与签名，避免发出不完整的包
  • 修复上一版本（1.3.2）安装后无法启动的问题

升级说明

  • 直接点「安装更新」即可，无需手动操作
  • 更新完成后，后续版本将从 https://app.bgm.fun/appcast.xml 检查更新
